intro: Most Croats are Catholic and speak Croatian; family, football and the sea are at the heart of life.

chapters.title: People
text: Zagreb is the capital and largest city, followed by Split, Rijeka and Osijek. Croatian is the official language, and there is a Serb minority. Many Croats have emigrated to Germany, Ireland and elsewhere, and the population is shrinking.

chapters.title: Croatian firsts
text: The necktie comes from cravats worn by Croatian soldiers in the 1600s; the word 'cravat' comes from 'Croat'. The Dalmatian dog is named after the region of Dalmatia, and the inventor Nikola Tesla was born in Smiljan, in today's Croatia.

keyTerms.meaning: A neck scarf, the ancestor of the tie.
